entities.name: Aykan
entities.description: A small plane known for prismatic magic, appearing in Magic: The Hidden Planeswalker.

entities.name: Isona Maive
entities.description: Native of Aykan said to have brought peace after decades of war; published articles about a spreading madness.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who went to Aykan to find Maive and found it frozen.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who followed Liliana to Aykan.

entities.name: Marit Lage
entities.description: Supposedly froze the plane of Aykan.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker listed as a visitor to Aykan.

events.summary: Liliana Vess, followed by Tezzeret, goes to Aykan to find Maive.
events.quote: Liliana Vess , followed by Tezzeret , went there to find Maive.

events.summary: Liliana discovers Aykan seems entirely frozen, supposedly by Marit Lage.
events.quote: Liliana discovered the plane seemed to have been entirely frozen, supposedly by Marit Lage .

relations.note: Native credited with bringing peace after decades of war.
relations.quote: Isona Maive is said to have brought peace to the world after it had been warring for decades.
